intro: The dig site is chaos. Between you and the landing pad: a mob of Boyz, and behind them, a Nob with a very big choppa.

victory_broken.text: Grizzgut staggers back, bleeding and furious. 'DIS AIN'T OVER, STUNTY!' He flees into the smoke, and the path to your ship is clear.

victory_negotiated.text: Grizzgut squints at you, then at the tunnels. 'Bigger fight dat way? ...Fine. But I'm comin' back for ya.' He stomps off, and his Boyz follow.

defeat.text: The world goes dark. You wake on your own deck, Dorrik's iron hand on your shoulder. 'Dragged you out myself. Don't make a habit of it.'

intro: An Ork raider swings across your bow, guns glowing. It is ugly, slow, and absolutely covered in weapons.

victory_broken.text: The raider's engines cough and die in a gout of black smoke. You don't stay to loot it. You burn hard for open space.

defeat.text: Your ship is crippled, venting air and spinning. The raider loses interest and turns back to the burning world. Dorrik patches the worst of it, at a cost.

intro: The Ork scout spots you and tries to bolt. It is fast, lightly armed, and carrying exactly what you need.

victory_broken.text: The scout spins out of control. You latch on, and Dorrik pulls its nav-cogitator out by the roots.

defeat.text: The scout guns you down and escapes. You limp back, but Ylsa caught its heading before it vanished.

withdrew.text: You break off. Ylsa caught enough of its heading to piece the route together.

intro: Grots are picking the vault clean. They have cutting torches, a lot of stolen tools, and no idea how to use either.

victory_broken.text: The grots flee squealing, dropping armfuls of looted vault plates.

victory_negotiated.text: The grot boss trades you the vault plates for a tin of ration bars. 'Pleasure doin' bizness, stunty!'

defeat.text: The grots swarm you and make off with your tools. They leave the vault plates behind. Grots can't read.

withdrew.text: You back out and take rubbings from the outer walls instead. Not ideal, but readable.

intro: The prison hulk stinks of rust and fungus. Somewhere ahead, past the jailers, Hrolla is shouting at someone.

victory_broken.text: Krugrot goes down hard. You find Hrolla in the last cell, chained, bloody, and grinning. 'Took your time, Captain.'

victory_negotiated.text: Krugrot decides the stunty isn't worth dying for. 'Take 'er. She bites.' Hrolla limps out on her own feet.

defeat.text: You're thrown out of an airlock and picked up by your own crew. Hrolla is still in there. The hulk will be on alert now.

withdrew.text: You pull back before the whole hulk wakes up. Hrolla is still in there.

intro: The freebooter cutter that has been bleeding Kharr's convoys turns to meet you, gun ports open.

victory_broken.text: The cutter limps away trailing fire. Kharr will hear who did it.

defeat.text: The cutter mauls you and escapes. Kharr is unimpressed, but notes that you tried.

withdrew.text: You break off. The cutter is still out there, and Kharr knows it.

intro: The warband has dug in around a captured mining station. The Kin miners are barricaded in the ore silos.

victory_broken.text: Zogbad and his boyz flee to their bikes. The miners come out of the silos cheering.

defeat.text: The warband drives you off. The miners hold out without you, barely.

withdrew.text: You pull back. The warband stays.

intro: The camp is a ring of welded scrap around pits full of Kin prisoners. There are guards everywhere.

victory_broken.text: Gutrip falls. You break the chains one by one. A broad miner named Brokka picks up a hammer and says, 'I'm coming with you.'

victory_negotiated.text: Gutrip sells you the whole pit for a promise you have no intention of keeping. Brokka spits at him on the way out, then joins your crew.

defeat.text: Your crew drags you out of the camp. A handful of prisoners escape in the confusion.

withdrew.text: You retreat. A few prisoners slip out with you.

intro: The pit gates slam. First Grizzgut, back again and bigger. Then the champion. The crowd wants blood, and they don't much care whose.

victory_broken.text: Bonecrusha topples. The pit goes silent, then erupts. They are chanting your name. Badly, but it is your name.

victory_negotiated.text: You talk the champion into a draw in front of the whole warband. No Ork has ever seen anything like it. They will tell this story for years.

defeat.text: You go down in the dust, but you went down fighting. The Orks respect that more than you expected.

withdrew.text: There is no leaving the pit.

intro: Grapples clang onto your hull. Pirates are cutting through the cargo airlock.

victory_broken.text: The pirates flee back to their ship, leaving a few crates behind.

victory_negotiated.text: You convince the pirates that your cargo is mostly rocks. It is. They leave.

defeat.text: The pirates help themselves to your hold and leave you tied to a stanchion.

withdrew.text: You seal the bulkheads and wait them out.

intro: An Ork loota ship drops out of the dark, guns first. It doesn't want you. It wants your parts.

victory_broken.text: The lootas go dark. You strip what you can before the wreck drifts away.

defeat.text: The lootas strip some plating off your hull and roar away, delighted.

withdrew.text: You burn away and lose them in the dark.

intro: There she is: the freebooter cutter from Karrak's bounty board, lurking in the belt.

victory_broken.text: The cutter strikes its colours. Karrak will pay.

defeat.text: The cutter gets away. Karrak won't pay for a ship you didn't catch.

withdrew.text: You let her go. Karrak won't pay for a ship you didn't catch.
